Audakopamasūtra
Bud. ref. in Abhidharma-Samuccayabhāṣya. See JBRS. XXXV. p.. 40-41.

Audavraji
ancient authority on gr. Bhaṭṭoji in Śabdakaustubha, the C. on the Pāṇinīyaśīkṣā, an. the a. of the Śikṣāprakāśa, ascribe the Ṛktantra of the Sv. to him. See Suryakanta's Lahore edn. of ṚT., Intro. p.. 33-4, 39. The Sv. [Page099-a. sarvānukramaṇī mentions Sāmatantra a. a. work of Audavraji, see Suryakanta, ib. p. 37. Mss. of Puṣpasūtra of the Sv. also mention Audavraji a. its a. See ib. p. 37. C.. Puṣpayaśas Audavraji in the list of Sv. sages in Vaṁśabrāhmaṇa. A Prācīna Audavraji is q. in Nāradaśikṣā, Ind. Ant. V. p. 195. Viśveśvara q. Audavraji in his C. on his own Kavīndrakarṇābharaṇa, K. M. Gucch. VIII. p. 86.
--Ṛktantra.
--Puṣpa (Phulla) sūtra. Adyar PL. p. 27.
--Śikṣā (?) Ind. Ant. V. p.. 195. 199.
--Sāmatantra.

Audāyacintāmaṇi
Pkt. gr. in 6 chs. based on Hemacandra's work. Text an. C. by Śrutasāgara, disciple of Vidyānandin. First 3 chs. ptd. from Vizagpatnam. See ABORI. XIII. p.. 52-53.
Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 22.

Auddālakāyanaśruti
Q. in Ānandatīrtha's Bhāgavatatātparyanirṇaya, Sarvamūla edn., p. 88a.

Auddālaki_Śvetaketu
ancient authority on Kāmaśāstra; q. by Vātsyāyana in the Kāmasūtra
